observations: The page number «26» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: the heading of chapter 33, in bold, centred; in the left margin «O 139v» beside it and «N 44v» beside L02.

L02-L28: the eclipses of the moon: with the time of the syzygy and the argument of latitude, the table shows whether an eclipse is possible («aptum»); the diameter of the shadow is divided into twenty digits of sixty minutes, the diameter of the moon into twelve; the partial phases, the immersion, «elzukut» (al-suqūṭ), Latin «casus», and the emersion, «elingile» (al-injilāʾ), «respiratio», and the totality, «elmukdh» (al-mukth), «mora». For the moon at its greatest distance the shadow has twenty digits, at its least distance twenty-one; between them both tables are entered and the difference taken. L15: «arabes» is letter-spaced. L28: «(anomaliam)», in italics within round brackets, explains «argumentum».

N01: the c of «defectu» has a speck in its counter, not joined to the letter, so that it looks like an e; transcribed «defectu». N02: a dark speck on the base line between «id» and «est»; not transcribed. N04: «retro (?)», the question mark upright, after a thin space. N08: the bracket after the note number 14 is a square bracket with its upper part missing; see the critical note. N12: «autem . . . elmukdh», three points.
The colons and semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (9-11 px measured; «concipitur ;» in N07, 7 px).

critical_notes.class: wrong note number and missing point
critical_notes.evidence: the apparatus has note 39 on «quodque . . . . reponendum» (N16); the text repeats 38, the number of the note on «a» in L27; and the sentence ends with «reponendum», before «Postea vero», where the full stop is not printed
critical_notes.impact: the variant of note 39 belongs here

critical_notes.evidence: the note on «in tabulam» (L28, «tabulam{sup:39})») is the note after note 39 on «quodque . . . . reponendum»: text and apparatus both number it 39 again, where it is 40
the note numbers of the apparatus are followed by a round bracket; after 14 a square bracket is printed, its upper part missing

the list of misprints, p. [237] (JP2 0271, L08), reads 39) and 40) for the 38) and 39) of this line, and 40) for 39) in the last line of the notes (critical notes AK07-CN044 and AK07-CN045): the note on «in tabulam» follows note 39 on «quodque . . . . reponendum»
